title: Senior Database Administrator | 7+years
description:
**About AppExert**

At AppExert, we enable top remote developers to work with interesting tech companies worldwide. We provide 100% remote full-time employment with options to work from one of our remote pods in Montreal, Toronto, Chennai, and Bangalore. If you're passionate about working with interesting companies and make a significant impact, AppExert is the ideal platform.

We’re humble and proud building the happiest remote developers community in India, enabling developers like you to follow their passions while staying closely connected to what genuinely matters to them. The dilemma of choosing between a gratifying career and a meaningful connection to your roots is no longer a concern.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented
**Database Administrator (DBA)**
to manage, maintain, and optimize our database systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, and reliability of databases across environments. This role requires strong expertise in database design, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting in both on-premise and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and maintain database systems (SQL Server / MySQL / PostgreSQL as applicable)
* Monitor database performance and ensure high availability and reliability
* Perform database tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies
* Manage backup, restore, and disaster recovery processes
* Implement and maintain database security, access controls, and compliance standards
* Troubleshoot database issues, including performance bottlenecks and failures
* Design and maintain database schemas, tables, views, and stored procedures
* Support application teams with database-related requirements and performance improvements
* Plan and execute database upgrades, patches, and migrations
* Monitor system health, logs, and alerts; take proactive actions to prevent issues
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams for deployment and scaling
* Maintain documentation for database configurations, processes, and procedures

**Requirements**

* 7+ years of experience as a Database Administrator
* Strong experience with
  **Microsoft SQL Server / MySQL / PostgreSQL**
* Proficiency in
  **SQL and query optimization techniques**
* Experience with
  **performance tuning, indexing, and execution plans**
* Hands-on experience with
  **backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies**
* Knowledge of
  **high availability solutions**
  (Replication, Clustering, Always On, etc.)
* Experience with
  **database security and access management**
* Familiarity with
  **cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP)**
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with
  **NoSQL databases**
  (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.)
* Familiarity with
  **CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices**
* Knowledge of
  **automation/scripting**
  (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
* Experience with
  **monitoring tools**
  (SQL Profiler, Azure Monitor, etc.)
* Understanding of
  **data warehousing and ETL processes**

**Why AppExert?**

At AppExert, our main objective is to cultivate a supportive community for remote developers, ensuring a strong sense of belonging. We offer a variety of benefits to ensure you can always work hard and have fun:

* Connect and collaborate with like-minded professionals from around the world, expanding your network and knowledge.
* Flexibility and freedom, allowing you to choose your own work location. Whether you prefer working from the comfort of your home, a bustling coffee shop, or a tranquil beach, the choice of location is entirely yours.
* Secure and reliable remote work environment, ensuring that our employees can enjoy the benefits of flexibility while having a solid foundation to thrive professionally.
* A supportive environment where you can sharpen your skills, receive valuable feedback and stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends.
* Robust infrastructure, effective communication channels, and remote collaboration tools.
* A healthy work-life balance by ensuring that our developers have a standard 40-hour workweek, allowing them to excel in their roles while maintaining their well-being.
* Paid time off so you can really recharge and enjoy life.
* Health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits to balance your heart, mind, and body.
* Virtual team building activities and social events - we foster a sense of connection among our team members, recognising the significance of staying united even in remote work settings using
* An amazing culture to top it all off!

title: Couchbase Database Administrator
description:
Preferred

Couchbase Administration Skills

• Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade, and maintain multi-node Couchbase clusters across development, test, staging, and production environments

• Manage Couchbase Data, Query, Index, Search, Analytics, and Eventing services based on workload requirements

• Administer buckets, scopes, collections, nodes, service quotas, replicas, compaction settings, and cluster rebalance activities

• Plan and execute node addition, removal, failover, recovery, cluster expansion, and capacity changes with minimal service disruption

• Support Couchbase Server on Linux and, where applicable, Couchbase Capella or Couchbase deployments on cloud and Kubernetes platforms

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Performance, Query, and Indexing

• Monitor cluster health, node utilization, disk and memory consumption, latency, throughput, rebalance status, replication queues, and service-specific metrics

• Tune memory quotas, vBuckets, indexes, compaction, query services, and workload placement for performance and stability

• Create, review, and optimize SQL++ queries, execution plans, Global Secondary Indexes, and index partitioning strategies

• Troubleshoot slow queries, indexing failures, hot nodes, skew, timeouts, out-of-memory conditions, and application connectivity issues

• Perform capacity planning, growth forecasting, workload analysis, and performance benchmarking for high-volume environments

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

High Availability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

• Design and maintain high-availability configurations using replicas, failover, rebalance, and resilient cluster topology

• Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cross Data Center Replication for disaster recovery and geographically distributed workloads

• Plan and execute full and incremental backups, restores, retention policies, archive management, and periodic recovery validation

• Develop and test disaster recovery procedures, including failover and failback runbooks, recovery objectives, and operational readiness

• Participate in business continuity exercises and resolve replication lag, conflicts, connectivity, and recovery-related issues

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Security and Compliance

• Implement role-based access control, least-privilege administration, service accounts, password policies, and periodic access reviews

• Manage TLS certificates and encryption in transit and at rest in accordance with enterprise security standards

• Configure auditing, logging, network controls, and secure connectivity between applications, clusters, and administrative tools

• Support vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance evidence, patch governance, and audit requests

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Automation, Monitoring, and Operations

• Automate routine administration, health checks, deployments, backup validation, and reporting using Shell, Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies

• Use Couchbase command-line utilities and management APIs for cluster operations, diagnostics, backup, and recovery

• Integrate metrics and alerts with enterprise monitoring platforms; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or comparable tools is preferred

• Support Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or Couchbase Autonomous Operator

• Perform incident, problem, change, release, service-request, and root-cause-analysis activities in line with ITIL processes

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Collaboration and Communication

• Work closely with application, cloud, DevOps, network, storage, security, and architecture teams to support reliable production services

• Advise development teams on document design, bucket, scope, and collection architecture, indexing, connection management, and efficient query patterns

• Lead technical troubleshooting during critical incidents and communicate impact, recovery actions, risks, and preventive measures to stakeholders

• Create and maintain standard operating procedures, runbooks, architecture documents, operational checklists, known-error records, and knowledge articles

• Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to operations team members

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Nice to Have

• Experience with Couchbase Capella, cloud migration, hybrid-cloud deployment, or platform modernization

• Knowledge of Couchbase Mobile, Sync Gateway, full-text search, Analytics, Eventing, or data integration patterns

• Experience migrating from relational or other NoSQL platforms to Couchbase

• Familiarity with Java or other Couchbase SDKs, CI/CD pipelines, and observability practices

• Couchbase or relevant cloud and database certifications

Additional Information

The role may require working in a 24x7 support model, including rotational shifts, scheduled maintenance, and on-call support for mission-critical production environments. The successful candidate should be comfortable coordinating with global teams and managing high-severity incidents under defined service-level commitments.

title: Chargebee - Senior Software Development Engineer - Revenue Story Modules
description:
**Job Description**
Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
  
  
Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Conde Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.
  
  
With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
  
  
**About The Team**
You'll join the Revenue Story Modules team, a cross-functional group of engineers, product managers, and designers based primarily in India and collaborating with global stakeholders.
  
  
The team builds reporting, insights, and revenue intelligence capabilities that help customers understand and operationalize their subscription revenue performance.
  
  
We work closely with Platform, Billing, Support, and GTM teams to deliver scalable solutions with strong correctness guarantees, performance, and reliability.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will own and deliver key product capabilities for our Revenue Story Modules.
  
  
You'll work end-to-end - from design to rollout - while partnering closely with Product and Engineering peers to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.
  
  
You will play a key role in improving code quality, performance, and operational excellence, and support junior engineers through mentorship and reviews.
  
  
**What You'll Do (role And Responsibilities)**

* Own the design, implementation, testing, and rollout of product features end-to-end.
* Build and maintain backend services with strong reliability, performance, and security standards.
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries, improve data correctness, and enhance performance for reporting/data workflows.
* Drive code quality through code reviews, testing practices, and refactoring initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into robust technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team-wide engineering best practices.

**What You'll Bring (required Skills And Experience)**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of software development experience delivering high-quality, scalable systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with Core Java.
* Strong hands-on experience with MySQL/PostgreSQL, SQL, and familiarity with NoSQL.
* Experience writing complex SQL queries and optimizing performance (query plans, indexes, scalability).
* Experience with microservices architecture and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Working knowledge / hands-on exposure to Javascript frameworks (React / Angular / Vue) is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work across teams.

**Nice To Have (preferred)**

* Experience designing/consuming RESTful APIs (added advantage).
* Experience with a query builder / query engine.
* Experience building reporting/analytics products or working in revenue/finance domains.
* Experience mentoring developers and leading technical initiatives within a team.
* Actively using AI tools for development workflows (coding copilots, etc.)

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
We're seeking an exceptional Data Platform Engineer to shape the strategic direction and architecture of our data infrastructure. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll co-own the overall platform architecture, set technical standards across the entire Data Engineering organization, and drive initiatives that directly impact our data strategy. You'll be a force multiplier—inspiring teams, mentoring senior engineers, and making architectural decisions that affect how the entire organization builds and operates data systems. We are in the midst of transforming our legacy infrastructure into a modern cloud-first platform, and you'll be instrumental in leading this technical evolution.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Strategic Platform Leadership
  
  

* Co-own and evolve the overall data platform architecture across all domains
* Guide the technical vision for the entire Data Engineering organization
* Drive platform initiatives that directly support the company's data strategy
* Lead the modernization of legacy systems while ensuring business continuity
* Identify and solve problems that span the entire Data Engineering org before they impact delivery
* Set the bar for excellence and serve as an inspiration across all engineering teams

Architecture & Technical Excellence
  
  

* Design and drive implementation of highly scalable platform architectures for multi-TB+ daily workloads
* Author and sign off on all RFCs and technical specifications that touch your domain(s)
* Define best practices and patterns that become standard across the organization
* Build self-service infrastructure that empowers hundreds of data consumers while maintaining reliability
* Design event-driven, real-time data architectures using Kafka and stream processing at scale
* Contribute to any codebase across the organization, setting quality standards through exemplary code

Platform Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Architect comprehensive Infrastructure as Code strategies and GitOps frameworks
* Design enterprise-grade security frameworks including encryption, zero-trust access controls, and compliance
* Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical platform services and drive observability strategy
* Lead complex incident response, conduct thorough post-mortems, and implement systemic improvements
* Drive platform reliability and performance optimization initiatives

Influence & Enablement
  
  

* Mentor IC9 and IC10 engineers, accelerating their technical growth and impact
* Collaborate across the entire Engineering organization as a thought partner
* Interact with executives and external stakeholders as a domain expert
* Democratize data access by empowering more teams to contribute to the data stack safely
* Identify hiring gaps and help define interview panels for critical technical roles
* Actively participate in and contribute to Data Engineering communities (conferences, Stack Overflow, vendor forums)

What You Bring
  
  
Deep Technical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and at least one additional programming language
* Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented design and software engineering principles
* Deep expertise with databases across paradigms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB
* Extensive Kafka ecosystem expertise: cluster management, Debezium, schema registry, Connect frameworks, stream processing
* Advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker at scale
* Expert knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures

Platform Engineering Mastery
  
  

* Proven track record architecting platforms processing multi-TB daily workloads
* Experience designing and operating systems supporting hundreds of concurrent users
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and scalability patterns
* Expert-level experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger)
* Mastery of data orchestration platforms like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
* Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data systems while ensuring zero business disruption

Experience & Background
  
  

* 10-15+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering or related field
* Track record of leading complex, org-wide technical initiatives
* History of driving architectural decisions that scale across large organizations
* Experience in high-growth or large enterprise environments
* Deep expertise with both modern and legacy technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects)

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and domains
* Excellence in mentoring senior engineers and accelerating their growth
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all levels
* Comfortable operating in high ambiguity and defining problems before solving them
* Track record of building collaborative relationships across engineering and business organizations
* Recognition as a thought leader in the Data Engineering community

Bonus Points
  
  

* Deep experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Looker, etc.)
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps architecture expertise
* Contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects
* Published technical articles, conference talks, or thought leadership in data platforms
* Expert knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and implementation at scale

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 Days:**
Understand our architecture deeply, identify systemic opportunities and risks, and begin influencing key technical decisions. Establish yourself as a go-to expert in your domain(s).
  
  
**First Year:**
Drive at least one major architectural initiative that impacts the entire Data Engineering organization. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to leadership and a mentor to senior engineers. Author multiple RFCs that set new standards.
  
  
**Ongoing:**
Continuously shape the technical direction of the organization, mentor the next generation of technical leaders, and maintain your position as one of the most knowledgeable experts in your domain(s) both internally and in the broader Data Engineering community.
  
  
Our Tech Stack
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure:**
AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, extensive cloud-native services)
  
  
**Data Technologies:**
Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, SQLMESH, Snowflake, dbt
  
  
**Languages & Frameworks:**
Python, SQL, Java, Scala, Docker, Kubernetes
  
  
**Monitoring & Observability:**
Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, ELK Stack, Jaeger
  
  
**Legacy Technologies:**
Apache Spark, Oracle, Postgres, SqlServer, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects

description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
A SAP Data Leader with 20+ years of experience serving as a strategic advisor to the C‑suite and leading large‑scale data transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA programs. The role requires deep expertise in modernizing legacy data landscapes using SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), Datasphere, and AI‑driven analytics.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Strategic Data Leadership And Architecture:**
Set the enterprise data strategy and roadmap, positioning SAP Business Data Cloud as the foundation for analytics and AI.
  
  
**Transformation Program Management:**
Lead complex SAP S/4HANA data migration and modernization programs at scale.
  
  
**Executive Advisory And Stakeholder Management:**
Advise C‑level leaders, shape strategic decisions, and demonstrate the business value of intelligent, data‑driven technologies.
  
  
**Data Governance And Quality:**
Establish enterprise‑wide data governance, including standards for data quality, stewardship, and master data management (MDG).
  
  
**Innovation And AI Adoption:**
Drive adoption of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions (e.g., SAP Joule, Predictive Analytics).
  
  
**Team Leadership & Mentorship:**
Lead and mentor global SAP teams, ensuring successful delivery across cross‑functional initiatives.
  
  
**Pre‑Sales & Business Development:**
Support business growth through solution design, proposal development, and client engagement.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience: 20+ years in IT, including 10+ years in SAP Data & Analytics architecture and strategy with 5+ years in Leadership roles
* Data Technologies: Proficiency in SAP Datasphere, BODS, Information Steward, and data migration tools (e.g., Syniti, LTMC).
* Architectural Skills: Experience designing modern data platforms and integrating SAP with non‑SAP ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks).
* Leadership: Proven capability to lead global teams and drive transformation in complex organizations.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business Administration.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to align data strategy with business objectives.
* Communication: Skilled at simplifying technical concepts for executive audiences.
* Problem‑Solving: Strong ability to resolve critical project risks and challenges.
* Data Modeling: Expertise in semantic modeling, CDS Views, and data lineage

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

You’ll implement FIS Quantum modules—including Cash Management, Investments, Intercompany, Debt, and FX—for large multinational firms, configuring each to address complex structures. You’ll establish secure banking connectivity via SWIFT and Host-to-Host, and rigorously test integrations. Responsibilities include preparing business requirements documents, blueprints, status reports, and updates, as well as providing go-live support and resolving post-implementation client queries to ensure smooth operations and high client satisfaction.

Controllership & Treasury Transformation (C&TT) is one of the offerings within the Finance Transformation portfolio of Deloitte US India Consulting. This Offering advises, implements, and delivers solution as-a-service relating to digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, enterprise performance strategies and technologies solutions. By taking a holistic view of these key business areas from strategy development through process design and technology enablement, we help our clients navigate their challenges while continuing to succeed in their business.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Possess 5–8 years of hands-on experience in the Corporate Treasury domain, supporting global organizations with treasury operations and solutions
* Expertise in FIS Quantum Treasury Management System (TMS), having completed 1–2 end-to-end implementation and rollout projects, which involved requirements gathering, module configuration, testing, data migration, and go-live support
* Deep, working knowledge of bank payment systems, including transaction processing, SWIFT and Host-to-Host integrations, and cash accounting processes, ensuring seamless banking connectivity and accurate financial reporting
* Proven ability to handle project-related communications—consistently engaging with stakeholders, collaborating with peers, managing client and team expectations, and effectively presenting value-driven recommendations to optimize treasury processes
* Excellent communication skills are mandatory, additional language skills desirable

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Adaptable and proactive approach to managing multiple workstreams and priorities in dynamic, fast-paced environments, demonstrating strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills to deliver quality outcomes under tight deadlines

* Quantum Certification is preferable

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai /Kolkata

description: Job DescriptionCSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments. 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms. Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services. Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems. Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines. Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale. Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads. Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues. Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability. Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills. ResponsibilitiesLead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations. Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products. Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns. Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets. Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale. Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services. Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies. Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps. description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years in data architecture, with at least 2+ years focused on Snowflake.
* Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data solutions using Snowflake’s cloud-based data platform. This position requires hands-on experience with cloud data warehousing, a deep understanding of Snowflake features and architecture, and the ability to lead complex data migration and integration projects across business units.
* Snowflake advanced features (Streams, Tasks, Zero Copy Cloning, Data Sharing).
* SQL, Python, or Spark for data transformation and scripting.
* Experience with ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, Talend, Matillion, Fivetran, etc.).
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Understanding of data visualization/BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Experience in developing on J2EE platforms, .Net platforms, RDBMS platforms (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server)
* Develop robust and scalable Snowflake data architectures.
* Design ETL pipelines, data governance frameworks, and efficient schema models.
* Ensure security, compliance, and cost optimization within Snowflake environments.
* Lead end-to-end implementation of Snowflake solutions, including integration with third-party data sources and downstream analytics tools.
* Write efficient SQL and leverage Snowflake’s features (e.g., Streams, Tasks, Time Travel, Cloning).
* Assess existing data warehouse solutions (e.g., Teradata, Redshift, SQL Server).
* Build strategies for migration to Snowflake, focusing on minimal disruption and maximum data integrity.
* Continuously optimize performance and cost through warehouse sizing, partitioning, and indexing strategies.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, Business Intelligence teams, and key business stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentor junior team members.
* Create documentation, conduct workshops, and manage Snowflake roadmaps.
* Implement robust RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
* Design and automate monitoring solutions for data quality, lineage, and platform health.
* Ensure platform compliance with relevant industry standards (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).

**Preferred:**

* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in Cloud Platform.
* Project management experience is a plus.
* Certified Associate or Professional

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: BC SECTOR-TMT-BPI-Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**OSS Technology Consultant – Blue Planet Inventory (BPI) - Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role, as a senior consultant in GDS Consulting, you will lead the implementation of Ciena/ Blue Planet products and integration with the telecommunications operators’ Operations Support Systems (OSS). You will be responsible for ensuring that a quality, integrated software solution is delivered in a timely manner, at budget, and to our client's satisfaction.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Delivery and Product implementation, configuration, extensions, and integrations for OSS systems involving Ciena Blue Planet’s suite of products with specific focus on Blue Planet Network Inventory (BPI).
* Actively drive & participate in Business Analysis and requirements gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Data Migration and Support.
* You will develop system, process and data requirements of the customer.
* You will map OSS software (Network Inventory) capabilities to those needs and build consensus around the solution, proposes technical solutions to system requirements.
* You will develop applicable process and system change documentation; Develop and distribute project related documentation.
* Write and maintain Java code, create Spring beans, and develop JUnit tests.
* Develop and extend GUI components such as grids and reports using core product modules.
* Adhere to established coding and documentation standards while extending core product components.
* Write and optimize database queries and procedures, primarily for Neo4j, PostgreSQL.
* Support debugging, deployment, and environment setup using tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong technical skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**Frontend Development:**

* Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SVG
* Frameworks/Libraries: Angular 2+, Node.js/npm, Gulp
* Testing: Protractor, Jasmine

**Backend Development:**

* Languages: Java 11+, J2EE
* Frameworks/Libraries: Maven, Spring (Data, Security, MVC), SpringBoot
* Testing: JUnit

**Databases:**

* Primary: Neo4j (Graph DB), PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB

**Additional Skills:**

* ElasticSearch, Camunda / BPMN / OSM / Workflow, Drools, Kafka integration, RESTful APIs (using Spring MVC), Docker, Kubernetes
* Programming Concepts: Algorithms, data structures, database concepts (relational and graph)

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Telecom, OSS (Operational Support Systems), Inventory Management
* Consultant with minimum of 5+ Years proven experience and significant knowledge in Telecom OSS Network Inventory.
* Experience in Ciena Blue Planet Inventory (BPI).
* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)
* Knowledge of and preferably certification in TMForum’s eTOM framework along with Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and Open APIs.
* Exceptional quantitative skills enabling identification of key business issues and progression of solutions.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Job Summary**
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.
* Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.
* Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.
* Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.
* Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.
* Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering
* Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.
* Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.
* Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.
* Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.
* Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering
* Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).
* Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.
* Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.
* Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.
* Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration
* Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.
* Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.
* Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.
* Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture
* Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).
* Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.
* Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.
* Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).
* Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning
* Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.
* Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.
* Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.
* Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.
* Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture
* Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.
* Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.
* Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.
* Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.
* Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship
* Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).
* Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.
* Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.
* Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Key skills :
  
  
Backup strategies, disaster
  
  
Recovery plans
  
  
Performance tuning,
  
  
Capacity/resource planning
  
  
Data Restoration
  
  
System Upgrades
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.
* Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).

**Required Technical Skills**

* Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.
* OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.
* Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.
* High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.
* Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.
* Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.
* Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.
* Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.
* Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.
* Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).
* Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).
* Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.
* Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.
* Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.
* Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

title: Technical Consultant - ERP
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Technical Consultant - ERP**
is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives.
  
The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions.
* Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management.
* Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology.
* Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues.
* Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases.
* Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation.
* Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues.
* Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment.
* Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications.
* Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll.
* Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization.
* Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities.
* Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures.
* Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success.
* Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5–8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience, including configuration and production support.
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6.
* Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine, including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered.
* Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management.
* Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills.
* Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors.
* Experience with Kronos Workforce Management version 8 or higher.
* Experience with Rsite, BSI TaxFactory/TUBs, and/or other SAP payroll tax solutions.
* Experience with SaaS HR/payroll solutions and enterprise application integrations.
* Experience coordinating with third-party application and managed-service providers.
* Experience with payroll tax compliance, year-end processing, and tax update testing.
* Experience leading SAP HR/Payroll projects, enhancements, or major production initiatives.

title: Senior Administrator, Systems
description:
**Title**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Senior Administrator, Systems
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously

**Minimum Qualifications, Education & Experience**

* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects

**Work Environment**

* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.
