title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  
  
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
* Ability to challenge existing approaches and introduce better engineering practices.

Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an experienced
**IT Analyst applications (Visualization & Power Platform)**
to join our
**India GCC – GCIO BI Services - CAT IT Division.**
**The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN / Chennai - WTC**
**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.**
**Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST**
****Job Description:****
**Role focus:**
Hands-on delivery across Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The IT Analyst will design, develop, enhance, and support business applications, dashboards, reporting solutions, and workflow automations for the Visualization team. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, supported by solid Snowflake and SQL capabilities. The successful candidate will work directly with business partners and technical teams to translate requirements into secure, scalable, user-friendly, and data-driven solutions. The role will also contribute to practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, analytics, and business decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support Power Apps solutions, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Develop workflow automation and system integration using Power Automate.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, scorecards, and operational analytics.
* Develop efficient DAX measures and Power Query transformations and optimize report performance and usability.
* Use Snowflake and SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data for applications and visualization solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and deliver fit-for-purpose outcomes.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, APIs, Snowflake, and other approved enterprise data sources.
* Apply security, access control, row-level security, data privacy, governance, and application lifecycle management practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Create clear technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and user support.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, Copilot, and automation to improve business processes and analytical experiences.
* Participate in Agile delivery, estimation, testing, release management, and continuous improvement activities.

Required Technical Competencies
  
  
Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, particularly Canvas Apps. Experience with Model-Driven Apps is desirable.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, scheduled flows, and integrations.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse, solution packaging, environment management, connectors, and application lifecycle management.
* Ability to design intuitive user experiences and reusable application components.

Power BI and Visualization
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Proficiency in data modeling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and report navigation.
* Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
* Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

Snowflake and SQL
  
  

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregations, views, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
* Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.
* Ability to incorporate AI-assisted features into apps, automation, and analytics solutions where appropriate.
* Knowledge of prompt design, responsible AI, data security, privacy, and human validation of AI-generated outputs.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters`s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 5 -7 years of relevant experience in Power Platform, business intelligence, visualization, analytics, or application development.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake.
* Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience supporting production applications, dashboards, and data solutions in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, REST APIs, SharePoint Online, or Teams integration.
* Exposure to Tableau or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable work management and CI/CD tool.
* Understanding testing practices, source control, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and support processes.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with global stakeholders.
* Experience in machine manufacturing or a related industrial domain is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and recommend practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Power Platform, analytics, AI, and data technologies.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Application Design, Architecture:**
Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

**Requirements Analysis:**
Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

**System and Technology Integration:**
Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

**System Testing:**
Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
* Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
* Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
* Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.

title: SAP Basis-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS CONSULTING – SAP BASIS SENIOR**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
  
  
You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
  
  
In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
* System /System copy
* ABAP + Java-dual stack
* Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText

**Certifications:**

* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Master Data Quality Manager
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation.The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained.

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data quality monitoring**

* Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data.
* Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards.
* Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions.
* Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records.
* Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes.
* Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

**2. Data Cleansing and Remediation**

* Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets.
* Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies.
* Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information.
* Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner.

**3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding**

* Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data.
* Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment.
* Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data.
* Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements.
* Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions.
* Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information.

**4. Data governance and standardization**

* Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data.
* Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained.
* Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality.
* Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures.
* Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation.

**5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support**

* Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information.
* Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions.
* Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues.
* Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices.

**6. Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress.
* Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action.
* Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes.
* Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
* Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment.
* Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented.
* Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically.
* Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products.
* Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms.
* Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting.
* Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes.
* Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

title: D&A MDG Solution Consultant
description:
**D&A MDG Solution Consultant**

**Position Overview:**

Join us as a SAP MDG (Master Data Governance) Solution Consultant for guiding our organization through the implementation and optimization of SAP MDG solutions. You’ll play a pivotal role in understanding business requirements related to master data management and translating them into technical solutions using SAP MDG. This role requires deep expertise in SAP MDG modules, data modeling, data governance best practices, and excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams.

**Typical Accountabilities**

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand master data management requirements, including data governance rules, data quality standards, and business processes.

Solution Design: Design comprehensive SAP MDG solutions tailored to meet business needs, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and compliance requirements.

Configuration and Customization: Configure SAP MDG modules to support data governance processes, including data modeling, workflows, data validation rules, and user interfaces,

**including:**

* Data Model Enhancement, Data Transfer (DIF/DEF), Data Replication Framework (DRF), Business Rules Framework plus (BRFplus)
* Configuration rule-based Workflow
* Integrating business process requirements with the technical implementation of SAP Master Data Governance
* User interface modelling (Design and Creation of UI, Value restriction, Define navigation elements of type Hyperlink or Push button, Data quality, Validation and Derivation rules)
* Process Modelling (Entity, Business Activity change, Request type, Workflow, Edition type,

Relationship, Data replication techniques, SOA service, ALE connection, Key value mapping, Data

transfer, Export import master data, Convert master data) Integration Management: Implement integrations between SAP MDG and other systems (such as ERP and BI) to ensure seamless data flow and consistency across the organization.

Data Quality Management: Define data quality metrics and implement data quality rules within SAP MDG to maintain high-quality master data.

Training and Documentation: Develop training materials and provide guidance to end-users on SAP MDG functionalities and best practices. Create documentation for configuration, customizations, and user guides.

Testing and Quality Assurance: Lead testing activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of SAP MDG solutions. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and address any issues or defects.

Change Management: Facilitate change management processes to ensure smooth adoption of SAP MDG solutions within the organization. Provide ongoing support and guidance to stakeholders during and after implementation.

Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on latest SAP MDG developments, trends, and best practices.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and optimization of existing solutions.

**Education, Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in SAP MDG implementation and customization.

 Proficiency in SAP MDG modules such as Material, Customer, Vendor, or Financials.

 Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and data governance principles.

 Experience with SAP integration technologies (e.g., IDoc, RFC, BAPI).

 Certification in SAP MDG is preferred.

**Position Summary**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Are you an experienced Data Engineer who has led the development of world-class software or digital products? Are you looking for an opportunity to expand your scope and lead products used by some of the biggest and most influential businesses around the world? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.
  
  
ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world’s largest professional services firm.
  
  
We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today’s data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER’s suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred. Our approach for addressing this complexity is simple: we combine Deloitte’s next-generation technology platforms with decades of experience in the consumer sector and a deep understanding of its unique issues and challenges to drive profitability and future growth for our clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. This role requires both technical fluency in data engineering and an analytical mindset capable of assessing data quality and real-world representativeness. The primary focus of this role is to establish expertise on our library of vendor licensed datasets, perform data pulls to extract insights from the datasets, link and join across datasets, assess the datasets and delivered insights for their validity and believability, and enable downstream data users, including account and product teams, to correctly leverage the data according to their project needs. The ideal candidate will have exceptional SQL and Python skills, expertise in Google BigQuery and PostgreSQL, and ability to convey complex data, concepts, and ideas in succinct, clear fashion to various business stakeholders. Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset is preferred.
  
  

* Work with Product Managers/Owners to understand how products can be used and should be implemented to solve client problems.

Collaborates with Product, GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting teams across India and the US.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

Product Forward Deployed Engineers bridge deep product and domain expertise with real client problems. title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery & Client Program Lead**

**Full Time | Chennai |**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape & help establish standards.

This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.

You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.

This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client-facing, with solid team-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* Own the end-to-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi, Qlik Replicate, AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.
* Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data warehousing, modelling, and reporting.
* Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and governance frameworks - and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.
* Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices.
* Lead technical implementation and stay hands-on where it matters - reviewing designs, unblocking the team, and building critical components.
* Own solution design decisions and their trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and business audiences.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.
* Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (scrum-master responsibilities).
* Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
* Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.
* Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.
* Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs, and acceptance criteria.
* Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.
* Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical audiences.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 3+ years in a data architecture capacity.
* Strong Snowflake experience - able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.
* Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices (RBAC, data security).
* Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and governance framework.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling - one or more of Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi - and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.
* Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.
* Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team-management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.
* Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business stakeholders.
* Experience running agile delivery - sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.
* Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.
* Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS + Talend + Boomi).
* Data governance, security, and role-based access / access-model design.
* Experience delivering into a large, standards-driven enterprise - ideally in manufacturing or a comparable industrial / operational domain.
* Migration, go-live, or platform-modernization experience.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change-management processes.
* Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.

**Certifications (one or more preferred)**

* SnowPro Core - or SnowPro Advanced: Architect
* AWS Certified - Solutions Architect or Data Engineer / Data Analytics
* Informatica Cloud (IICS) certification
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
* Professional Scrum Master (PSM) / Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
* ITIL Foundation

title: Murex Back Office Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Murex Back Office consultant to oversee and manage all post-trade operations within our Murex MX.3 platform. The ideal candidate will have deep functional and technical expertise in Murex Back Office modules, a strong understanding of capital markets products, and hands-on experience in managing Murex implementation, upgrades, and support. This role involves acting as the primary point of contact for business users, translating complex business requirements into Murex solutions, and ensuring the smooth and compliant functioning of all back-office processes.

**Responsibilities:**

* System Configuration and Implementation: Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Murex Back Office workflows, including Contract, Event, Deliverable, and Exchange Workflows, to meet business requirements.
* Business Analysis and Solution Design: Act as the liaison between business stakeholders (including Operations and Treasury) and IT teams. Conduct user requirement workshops, document functional and technical specifications, and propose robust solutions.
* MxML Integration and Reporting: Utilize MxML Exchange to create and enhance interfaces for system integration, data import/export, and communication with upstream and downstream systems. Develop and maintain Datamart reports and custom extractions.
* Production Support and Troubleshooting: Provide expert-level support for Murex Back Office modules. Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues related to confirmations, settlements, payments, netting, fixing, and accounting.
* Upgrade and Enhancement Management: Assist in Murex upgrade projects by performing impact analysis, conducting upgrade-related testing and reconciliation, and implementing new features.
* Regulatory and Compliance Expertise: Ensure all back-office processes and configurations adhere to regulatory requirements, such as SWIFT formats (MT and ISO20022), OSP, and other market standards.
* User Training and Mentorship: Develop and conduct training sessions for back-office users on Murex functionalities. Mentor junior analysts and team members.
* Test Management: Lead or assist in the preparation and execution of system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), including writing test cases and obtaining user sign-offs.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience (required)
* Extensive experience in Analyzing, Developing, Managing and Implementing various stand-alone client-server applications using Python, Django and mapping the requirements to the systems.
* 3-5+ years of experience designing in Python
* Experience in working with data at scale.
* Experience with Murex implementation.
* Knowledge of collateral activities, margin, and credit risk.
* Familiarity with Agile or DevOps methodologies.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Director-Enterprise Data Platform
description:
**Job Title/Role: Director - Enterprise Data Platform**
**Mode of hire: Full-Time**
**Base Location: Guindy, Chennai**
**Mode of work: Hybrid/ Roster Model**
**Shift Timing: General Shift + Overlapping US time zone**
**Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
**Department: Engineering**
**About The Role**
The Data Platform Leader is responsible for defining, building, and operating the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), a centralized, governed, and scalable data foundation that enables enterprise analytics and accelerates insight delivery. This role owns the end-to-end data platform capability as a strategic enterprise asset, including vision, investment direction.
  
  
The role leads the design and execution of a modern AWS Native Lakehouse platform, ensuring secure, high performance, and self-service access to trusted data across the organization. It requires a balance of deep technical expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate within a federated data model that supports domain ownership while maintaining centralized governance.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Platform Strategy**

* Define and execute the enterprise data platform strategy and roadmap
* Design and evolve a modern AWS native lakehouse architecture
* Establish scalable, reusable data platform patterns and standards
* Drive migration from legacy Microsoft based data platforms
* Define and evolve the federated data operating model, including domain responsibilities and data product standards

**Platform Delivery & Operations**

* Own delivery and ongoing operation of the data platform
* Oversee development of data ingestion pipelines and transformation frameworks
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, and scalability
* Implement monitoring, observability, and operational controls
* Optimize platform cost efficiency across storage, compute, and data processing workloads

**Data Governance & Security**

* Define and enforce data governance standards, policies, and controls
* Implement fine-grained access control using AWS Lake Formation
* Enable enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, and discovery (e.g., AWS DataZone)
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and audit requirements

**Technology Leadership**

* Lead tooling and technology decisions across the platform ecosystem
* Define reference architectures for batch, streaming, and real-time processing
* Standardize orchestration and data processing patterns
* Own integration strategy and interoperability with analytics and BI tools such as Power BI, SQL based platforms, Agentic AI capabilities (e.g., model context protocol, data access patterns for AI workloads)

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers and analysts
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, and quality frameworks
* Build capabilities in modern data engineering, governance, and platform operations
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Drive alignment with business domains to onboard and scale data products
* Enable self-service data access and consumption
* Drive alignment with architecture, security, and analytics teams
* Act as the primary escalation point for platform related decisions

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related fields
* 3+ years of experience leading data engineering or platform teams

The HRIS Specialist - Oracle HCM Functional Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. ****What You Will Do:****

* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) and provide day-to-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.

* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR users, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.

****What You Will Need:****
**Education and Experience**

* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience with strong hands-on functional expertise in Oracle HRMS, including configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.

****Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities****

* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions
* Strong customer-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.

****Job Description****
The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure cloud environment.
  
  
This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. Working as part of the Infrastructure team, this role collaborates closely with Application, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong infrastructure and cloud professional with expertise across on-premises data center technologies, Microsoft Azure services, enterprise storage platforms, Windows Server, Hyper-V, and Active Directory. A strong focus on Azure infrastructure and code provisioning.
  
  
This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.

* Administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Dell server infrastructure, enterprise storage platforms, and Windows-based infrastructure services.
* Manage and maintain enterprise file servers, file shares, permissions, and storage resources.
* Support and maintain clustered Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments.
* Administer and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS infrastructure services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments.
