* Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform as a core competency of cloud administration for provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis across server, storage, virtualization, cloud, networking, DNS, authentication, and security layers.
* Provide 3rd Level infrastructure support for complex technical incidents and service requests locally and remotely.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

****The Following Certifications Are Considered An Asset:****

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, Virtualization, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Cisco CCNA or similar

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise infrastructure environments in a complex, global environment.
* Strong experience with Dell servers, storage systems including NAS / SAN, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V and file services.
* Strong Azure administration experience including provisioning, permissions, firewall and DNS management.
* Hands-on Terraform experience for Infrastructure as Code deployments
* Experience working within ITIL-based support processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar systems and technologies.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Knowledge of AWS core infrastructure and cloud services.
* Experience with Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

**Key Competencies**

* Self-motivated and highly independent.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Continuous learning mindset.

**Success Profile**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on Infrastructure and Cloud professional who successfully bridges traditional data center operations with modern cloud engineering practices. They combine deep expertise in Windows infrastructure, virtualization, storage, and enterprise networking with strong Azure administration and automation capabilities. Through a proactive approach to troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, they ensure reliable, secure, and scalable hybrid infrastructure platforms. The candidate is highly self-motivated, continuously expands their technical expertise, and takes full ownership of supporting and improving business-critical systems and services across both on-premises and cloud environments.

title: Associate Senior Solutions Architect - req38675
description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**
Job #: req38675
  
  
Organization: World Bank

Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
**About Us**
Foodhub currently has 30,000+ restaurant, takeaway, stadia, hotel and bar clients in the UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, Nigeria, Grenada and ANZ. Today, Foodhub powers the technology behind many different QSR's, stadia and venue, online order, delivery and POS businesses, giving them a multi-solution tech stack to drive their business forward and open new revenue streams.
  
  
From the moment a consumer is thinking of placing an order, to the time the order arrives at their door and a review is posted to social media, Foodhub has solutions to drive the consumer experience, whilst adding extra value via our ecosystem of partners. The Foodhub Tech Stack is extensive: from Web and Mobile Ordering to 3rd Party Order Aggregation, Dispatch and Self-Delivery, complete Hardware/Software POS systems, extensive array of POS integrations, On-Premise Kiosks, QR Code Ordering and Payment, Table-side Mobile Order/Receipt Printers, plus an extensive product and development team to support all of this.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior BI Developer with 3-4 years of experience to turn business data into clear, reliable reports and dashboards. You will work closely with business teams to understand their questions, build the data models behind the answers, and present insights that support better decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI orAmazon QuickSight. Write and optimise SQL queries to extract, transform and validate data from multiple sources.
* Build and maintain data models, datasets and calculated fields that support reporting needs.
* Work with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business questions into KPIs and reports.
* Analyse trends, patterns and performance metrics, and share clear insights with business teams.
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency through regular checks and validation.
* Automate recurring reports and improve existing dashboards for performance and usability.
* Document data sources, report logic and definitions of key metrics. Support and guide junior analysts or developers on BI best practices.
* Ability to explain data findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.
* Nice to have Experience with Python for data analysis or automation.
* Familiarity with ETL tools or data pipeline concepts.
* Exposure to AWS services such as S3, Athena or Redshift.
* Experience in a SaaS, e-commerce or customer support analytics environment.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, experience in banking systems, and a client-focused approach.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Database Administrator**
to take end-to-end ownership of database reliability, availability, performance, security, backup, recovery, and operational standards across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.

This is a hands-on senior role requiring expertise in designing and building database environments from scratch, implementing high availability and disaster recovery, troubleshooting complex production issues, and establishing consistent database operations across projects.

The successful candidate will lead database architecture, implementation, monitoring, performance optimization, maintenance, production support, and continuous improvement while working closely with clients, infrastructure teams, application teams, and implementation partners.

Key Responsibilities1. SQL Server Architecture and Administration

* Design, install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain enterprise SQL Server environments across on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures.
* Build database environments from scratch, including instance configuration, storage, service accounts, security, memory, CPU, tempdb, ports, and operational jobs.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Manage availability replicas, synchronization modes, quorum, failover policies, listeners, DNS, IPs, subnets, firewall rules, and application connectivity.
* Design multi-site high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including read-only workload routing.
* Perform database health checks, configuration comparisons, controlled failovers, and DR exercises.

2. Performance Monitoring and Optimization

* Proactively identify expensive queries, blocking, deadlocks, high CPU/I/O/memory consumption, long-running transactions, and database connectivity issues.
* Use Query Store, execution plans, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, and diagnostic tools to identify root causes.
* Troubleshoot cardinality estimation, memory grants, query spills, parallelism, scans, sorts, hash operations, parameter sensitivity, and latch contention.
* Diagnose tempdb growth, transaction-log pressure, storage bottlenecks, failed jobs, and resource-capacity issues.
* Optimize queries, indexes, statistics, configuration, and resource allocation in collaboration with application and infrastructure teams.
* Establish performance baselines and capacity forecasts for CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, logs, backups, and database growth.
* Address recurring performance issues through permanent corrective actions rather than temporary workarounds such as unnecessary restarts or database shrinking.

3. Indexing, Maintenance and Partitioning

* Develop and maintain database maintenance jobs for index optimization, statistics updates, integrity checks, backups, cleanup, and reporting.
* Define workload-specific index rebuild/reorganization and statistics-update strategies.
* Analyze fragmentation, page splits, index usage, duplicate or overlapping indexes, fill factor, clustering keys, and high-DML workloads.
* Design and maintain table and index partitioning for large, high-volume databases, including partition functions, schemes, filegroups, and retention policies.
* Implement sliding-window strategies, partition switching, archival, purging, and partition-level maintenance.
* Validate partition elimination and assess the impact of maintenance and partition changes on query performance, replication, transaction logs, and availability.

4. Backup, Recovery and Disaster Recovery

* Design and implement backup and recovery strategies aligned with agreed Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs).
* Manage full, differential, transaction-log, PostgreSQL physical/logical, and other appropriate backups.
* Implement encryption, compression, retention, off-site storage, monitoring, alerting, and backup-access controls.
* Conduct regular restore and point-in-time recovery tests, validate backup integrity and transaction-log chains, and maintain recovery evidence.
* Develop documented recovery procedures for data corruption, accidental deletion, infrastructure failure, cluster failure, and site-level disasters.

5. PostgreSQL Administration

* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain PostgreSQL environments.
* Build and administer highly available clusters using streaming replication and technologies such as Patroni, etcd/Consul, repmgr, or equivalent solutions.
* Manage primary/standby nodes, replication slots, WAL, synchronous/asynchronous replication, connection routing, and failover procedures.
* Implement backup and point-in-time recovery using pgBackRest, Barman, native utilities, or approved enterprise tools.
* Monitor replication lag, connections, locks, long-running transactions, WAL growth, checkpoints, storage, table/index bloat, and database health.
* Tune PostgreSQL configuration and queries using pg\_stat\_statements, EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, logs, and wait-event analysis.
* Manage VACUUM, autovacuum, ANALYZE, REINDEX, statistics, permissions, authentication, TLS, certificates, and security hardening.
* Plan and test failovers, switchovers, recovery procedures, major-version upgrades, and rollback strategies.

6. Security, Replication and Connectivity

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **10+ years**
  of database administration experience, including business-critical production systems.
* **7+ years**
  of strong, hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration experience.
* Proven experience building SQL Server environments from scratch and implementing enterprise high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of WSFC, Always On Availability Groups, listeners, quorum, multi-node failover, and multi-site architectures.
* Strong SQL Server performance-tuning expertise covering Query Store, execution plans, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, indexing, statistics, memory, parallelism, tempdb, and transaction logs.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise backup, restore, point-in-time recovery, and DR testing.
* Experience managing large, partitioned, high-DML, and high-transaction-volume databases.
* Practical PostgreSQL administration experience covering cluster setup, replication, backups, recovery, maintenance, monitoring, security, and performance tuning.
* Strong T-SQL skills, working knowledge of PostgreSQL SQL, and scripting/automation capabilities.
* Proven experience working with infrastructure, application, security, DevOps, vendor, and client teams.
* Ability to lead critical production incidents and communicate technical findings to technical and management stakeholders.
* Experience preparing architecture documents, implementation guides, operating procedures, health-check reports, and root-cause analyses.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in banking, fintech, payments, or other regulated, high-availability environments.
* Experience supporting geographically distributed production and DR sites.
* SQL Server transactional replication experience.
* Exposure to Azure SQL, SQL Server on Azure VMs, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Redgate, SolarWinds, Dynatrace, SCOM, Grafana/Prometheus, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Experience automating database builds, configuration validation, maintenance, and health checks.

Key Success Measures

* Database availability and reliability against agreed service targets.
* Backup success and independently verified restore capability.
* Compliance with RPO/RTO targets and successful DR/failover exercises.
* Reduction in recurring incidents, blocking, deadlocks, uncontrolled tempdb growth, and performance issues.
* Improved critical-query response times and database capacity planning.
* Healthy SQL Server Availability Groups and PostgreSQL replication.
* Timely completion of maintenance, patching, certificate renewals, recovery testing, and capacity reviews.
* Closure of database-readiness risks before production deployment.
* Consistent adoption of database standards, runbooks, and operational documentation.

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
Citi is seeking an experienced, high-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database-as-a-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi-region banking systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Enterprise Database Architecture & Technical Strategy Architect, design, and deliver end-to-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments. Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
* Modernization, DBaaS & Cloud Enablement Lead migration initiatives from legacy on-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS). Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling. Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re-platform and refactor applications for cloud-native persistence layers.
* High Availability, Replication & Scalability Engineering Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets & Sharded Clusters). Establish cross-region and multi-data-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
* Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning & Diagnostics Spearhead deep-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems. Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks. Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
* Security, Vulnerability Management & Access Control Enforce end-to-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in-transit, and privileged access controls. Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non-compliant instances across the fleet. Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub). Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation. Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
* Continuity of Business (COB) & Disaster Recovery (DR) Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills. Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point-in-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site-level disasters. Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
* Governance, Risk, Audit & Regulatory Compliance Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments. Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Vendor Engagement Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams. Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures. Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
* Required Qualifications, Experience & Certifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large-scale, enterprise financial services environment. Core Technical Competencies: In-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12+, Patroni, Connection Pooling). Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures. Demonstrated hands-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols. Certifications (Preferred): Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional Key Leadership & Soft Skills Proven track record of managing high-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. Strong ownership mindset, problem-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: Senior Database Administrator – Microsoft SQL Server & PostgreSQL
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Senior Database Administrator will own database reliability, availability, performance, security, recoverability, and operational standards across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can design and build database environments from scratch, troubleshoot complex production issues, guide clients and infrastructure partners, and establish consistent operational practices across projects.

The successful candidate must be capable of taking end-to-end ownership—from architecture and installation through monitoring, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, maintenance, production support, and continuous improvement.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Microsoft SQL Server Architecture and Implementation**

* Design, install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain enterprise SQL Server environments.
* Build SQL Server environments from the ground up, including instance configuration, storage layout, service accounts, ports, security, memory allocation, CPU settings, tempdb, and operational jobs.
* Design and implement Windows Server Failover Clustering and SQL Server Always On Availability Groups.
* Configure and troubleshoot availability replicas, synchronization modes, quorum, failover policies, endpoints, and Availability Group listeners.
* Define listener, DNS, IP, subnet, firewall, load-balancing, routing, and application-connectivity requirements with client infrastructure teams.
* Design multi-site, disaster-recovery, and read-only workload-routing solutions.
* Plan and execute controlled failover and disaster-recovery exercises.
* Support standalone, clustered, virtualized, on-premises, cloud, and hybrid SQL Server deployments.
* Conduct health checks and configuration comparisons across database nodes to identify inconsistencies in patch levels, memory, parallelism, storage, tempdb, and other settings.

**2. SQL Server Performance Monitoring and Optimization**

* Establish proactive monitoring for expensive, long-running, blocking, high-CPU, high-I/O, and high-memory queries.
* Use Query Store, execution plans, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking and deadlock analysis, and other diagnostic capabilities to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Analyze execution plans for poor cardinality estimates, memory-grant problems, spills, scans, expensive sorts, hash operations, spools, parameter sensitivity, and inefficient parallelism.
* Troubleshoot sustained CPU, memory, storage, and transaction-log pressure and distinguish infrastructure-capacity problems from query, schema, or configuration problems.
* Investigate abnormal tempdb growth and determine whether consumption is caused by user objects, internal objects, version-store activity, query spills, index operations, or long-running transactions.
* Configure and maintain tempdb based on workload requirements, including file count, equal file sizing, initial sizing, autogrowth, disk placement, and capacity thresholds.
* Diagnose blocking, deadlocks, latch contention, excessive waits, failed jobs, slow transactions, and database connectivity issues.
* Recommend and validate query rewrites, indexing changes, statistics updates, configuration changes, and resource-capacity improvements.
* Establish performance baselines and capacity forecasts for database growth, CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, transaction logs, and backup requirements.
* Work with application teams to prevent recurring heavy-query and high-DML performance problems rather than relying on restarts, shrinking, or additional infrastructure as temporary workarounds.

**3. Indexing, Fragmentation and Statistics Management**

* Design and implement database maintenance jobs for index optimization, statistics updates, integrity checks, backups, cleanup, and operational reporting.
* Establish workload-appropriate thresholds for index reorganization, rebuilds, and statistics updates rather than applying uniform rules to every database.
* Analyze rapidly recurring fragmentation, page splits, wide-table design, clustering-key selection, fill factor, index usage, and high-DML access patterns.
* Tune fill factor selectively for frequently modified indexes while evaluating the storage, cache, and I/O trade-offs.
* Review duplicate, overlapping, unused, missing, and excessively wide indexes.
* Plan index-maintenance windows that minimize blocking, replication impact, transaction-log growth, Availability Group latency, and production disruption.
* Measure the business and query-performance impact of fragmentation rather than treating the fragmentation percentage alone as the success criterion.

**4. Table Partitioning and Data Lifecycle Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain table and index partitioning strategies for large and high-volume databases.
* Define appropriate partition keys, functions, schemes, filegroups, boundaries, and retention models.
* Implement sliding-window strategies, partition switching, archival, purging, and future-partition creation.
* Perform partition-level index and statistics maintenance where appropriate.
* Ensure aligned indexes and validate the impact of partitioning on query plans, replication, backups, storage, and operational jobs.
* Review existing partitioned tables to confirm that partition elimination is occurring and that the implementation provides measurable operational or performance value.
* Coordinate partition changes carefully for high-DML and replicated tables.

**5. Backup, Recovery and Disaster Recovery**

* Define backup and recovery strategies based on agreed Recovery Point Objectives and Recovery Time Objectives.
* Implement and monitor full, differential, transaction-log, copy-only, and PostgreSQL physical or logical backups as appropriate.
* Configure backup encryption, compression, retention, off-site storage, cleanup, alerting, and access controls.
* Regularly test restores and maintain evidence that databases can be recovered within agreed targets.
* Prepare documented recovery procedures for database corruption, accidental deletion, infrastructure failure, Availability Group failure, and site-level disaster.
* Validate transaction-log chains, backup integrity, recovery models, point-in-time recovery, and backup-storage capacity.
* Ensure backup success is not treated as proof of recoverability without periodic restoration testing.

**6. PostgreSQL Administration**

* Design, install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain PostgreSQL database environments.
* Build and maintain highly available PostgreSQL clusters using streaming replication and suitable cluster-management or failover technologies.
* Configure primary and standby nodes, replication slots, WAL management, synchronous or asynchronous replication, connection routing, and failover procedures.
* Understand and administer technologies such as Patroni, etcd/Consul, repmgr, pgBouncer, HAProxy, or equivalent solutions.
* Implement PostgreSQL backup and point-in-time recovery using appropriate technologies such as pgBackRest, Barman, native utilities, or approved enterprise tools.
* Monitor replication lag, WAL growth, connection consumption, locks, long-running transactions, checkpoint behavior, table and index bloat, storage growth, and database health.
* Tune PostgreSQL configuration parameters based on workload, memory, CPU, storage, concurrency, and recovery requirements.
* Analyze slow queries using pg\_stat\_statements, EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, PostgreSQL logs, wait events, and relevant monitoring tools.
* Manage VACUUM, autovacuum, ANALYZE, REINDEX, statistics, bloat, and routine maintenance.
* Administer PostgreSQL roles, permissions, authentication, TLS, certificates, auditing, and security hardening.
* Plan and test PostgreSQL failover, switchover, recovery, major-version upgrades, and rollback procedures.

**7. Database Security and Compliance**

* Establish secure database configuration standards for SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
* Implement least-privilege access, role-based permissions, privileged-account controls, password and authentication standards, and periodic access reviews.
* Configure and support encryption at rest and encryption in transit, including certificate lifecycle and expiry monitoring.
* Work with application teams to validate encrypted connection settings, driver compatibility, listener certificates, and certificate trust.
* Support database auditing, security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and regulatory evidence requirements.
* Maintain secure service accounts, database links, linked servers, replication accounts, backup credentials, and monitoring accounts.
* Ensure database credentials and other secrets are managed through approved secret-management solutions.

**8. Replication, Integration and Connectivity**

* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot SQL Server transactional replication and other approved data-distribution mechanisms.
* Assess the effect of schema, index, and partitioning changes on replicated databases.
* Diagnose replication latency, agent failures, data inconsistencies, transaction-log growth, and subscriber performance.
* Troubleshoot database logins, drivers, connection strings, DNS, listener routing, firewall rules, TLS trust, and connection-pooling problems.
* Maintain an inventory of applications, jobs, monitoring systems, linked servers, reporting services, batch processes, and other database clients.

**9. Client and Partner Technical Leadership**

* Act as the senior database authority for internal teams, implementation partners, and client infrastructure teams.
* Define minimum standards and reference architectures for production, non-production, high-availability, and disaster-recovery database environments.
* Review database designs proposed by clients or partners and identify availability, performance, security, capacity, backup, and supportability risks.
* Provide clear build guides, configuration baselines, maintenance standards, monitoring requirements, backup policies, and operational runbooks.
* Challenge unsafe designs and incomplete implementations using technical evidence and business-impact analysis.
* Lead technical workshops covering cluster architecture, listener configuration, failover, backups, monitoring, maintenance, partitioning, security, and recovery.
* Guide less-experienced DBAs and provide structured knowledge transfer to support and delivery teams.
* Take ownership of complex database incidents through diagnosis, remediation, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective action.

**Operational Ownership**

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.

We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description** 
 – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
 



**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
 



 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
 



 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
 



 • Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
 



 • Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
 



 • Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
 



 • Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
 



 • Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
 



 • Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
 



 • Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
 



 • Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
 



 • Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
 



 • Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
 



 • Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
 



 • Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.
 



**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking** 




 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
 



 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
 



 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
 



 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
 



 • Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
 



 • Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
 



 • Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
 



 • Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
 



 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
 



 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid night shift role focuses on managing product information and master data to support efficient order management and trading operations for an MNC. The SME will optimize data flows between systems ensure accuracy of product and order records and collaborate with cross functional teams to improve retail order processes. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction and stable trading performance by maintaining reliable data foundations and supporting continuous improvement a
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end ownership of product information and master data flows for order management and trading systems ensuring accurate synchronized data across core platforms to support consistent execution and reliable reporting
* Manage creation update and maintenance of product master records including attributes hierarchies pricing and availability so that downstream order and trading processes operate with clean structured data
* Coordinate closely with order management operations teams to analyze data issues impacting order capture fulfillment and settlement and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and reduce manual interventions
* Collaborate with trading and commercial stakeholders to define data rules for item setup bundle management and promotional constructs ensuring that business strategies are reflected reliably in system configurations
* Monitor nightly data loads and interface jobs across hybrid environments addressing exceptions in near real time to secure uninterrupted processing and timely visibility for global teams
* Design and maintain data quality checks and validation routines that detect anomalies in product and order data enabling early remediation and continuous improvement of master data standards
* Document functional data models for order management and trading processes translating complex concepts into clear reference materials that support onboarding and knowledge sharing across teams
* Partner with technology teams to refine mapping logic between product information management master data management and order platforms focusing on performance scalability and resilience of integrations
* Support incident analysis for data related defects in night shift operations providing structured root cause insights and proposing pragmatic solutions that enhance customer experience and operational stability
* Contribute to process optimization initiatives across retail order flows by proposing enhancements to data structures configuration rules and workflows that reduce cycle times and improve order accuracy
* Engage with stakeholders in hybrid working sessions to gather requirements for new product and order data capabilities and convert them into well defined specifications that guide implementation and testing
* Perform impact assessments for product and master data changes across reporting billing and trading processes ensuring that dependencies are understood and that transitions are executed safely without disruption
* Promote adoption of master data governance practices through clear communication of standards guidance on best practices and active participation in forums that strengthen data discipline across the organization


**Qualifications**
* Possess four to seven years of hands on experience as a subject matter expert in product information and master data within complex order management and trading environments demonstrating strong ownership of data outcomes
* Bring solid practical expertise working with core order management platforms and trading systems including configuration troubleshooting and data analysis to keep high volume operations running smoothly
* Apply demonstrated exposure to retail order management scenarios such as omnichannel ordering and inventory visibility translating domain understanding into better data design and process alignment
* Show capability in documenting requirements user stories and data dictionaries in a clear and structured manner making it easier for cross functional teams to deliver enhancements and maintain solutions
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills using data profiling and issue analysis techniques to identify root causes of product and order data problems and to recommend sustainable corrective actions
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model and dedicated night shift environment maintaining proactive communication and coordination with onshore and offshore partners without needing travel
* Exhibit familiarity with master data management principles including governance stewardship and lifecycle management applying them to improve reliability and reusability of product and order data assets

B2B and B2C), and AWS (Control Tower, Landing Zone, AD Sync, EC2, Backup, VPC, Transit Gateway, S3, CloudTrail and CloudWatch) DR/Business continuity testing.

**Job Description** 




 Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant – ServiceNow \& Salesforce
 



 Position Overview
 



 We are looking for an
 **Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **ServiceNow and Salesforce** 
 to configure, administer, automate, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise service management and customer operations platforms.
 



 The successful candidate will work across both platforms, translating business requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, integrations, and governed platform solutions. The role requires a strong understanding of
 **IT Service Management (ITSM), CRM, platform administration, automation, scripting, data security, integration, testing, and release management** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ServiceNow Administration \& Configuration
 


* Administer and configure ServiceNow instances, including tables, forms, lists, roles, groups, ACLs, notifications, and scoped applications.
* Configure and support ITSM processes including:
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Enablement
* Request Fulfilment
* Service Level Management
* Work with the CMDB and Common Service Data Model to maintain service\-aware processes.
* Configure UI and data policies, client scripts, business rules, notifications, and other platform components.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Studio and App Engine Studio.
* Build workflows and automations using Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
* Configure Service Catalog items, record producers, approvals, and Virtual Agent topics.
* Develop and troubleshoot server\-side scripts using GlideRecord and related ServiceNow APIs.
* Create and consume REST APIs and work with Import Sets and Transform Maps.



 Salesforce Administration \& Development
 


* Configure Salesforce objects, fields, record pages, relationships, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field\-level security.
* Design scalable Salesforce data models using lookup, master\-detail, and junction relationships.
* Build business automation using Salesforce Flow Builder.
* Configure validation rules, duplicate management, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, and automation where declarative capabilities are insufficient.
* Write efficient SOQL queries and bulk\-safe DML operations.
* Develop and maintain Lightning Web Components.
* Implement appropriate unit testing and asynchronous processing.



 Integration \& Data Synchronisation
 


* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce.
* Work with authenticated APIs, OAuth 2\.0, named credentials, callouts, and platform events.
* Design canonical data models and appropriate integration patterns.
* Configure and support middleware/orchestration solutions such as
 **n8n or MuleSoft** 
 .
* Design conflict\-safe data synchronisation, including duplicate, retry, loop, and failure handling.
* Monitor integrations and troubleshoot data and API issues.



 Governance, Testing \& Release Management
 


* Follow platform governance and enterprise architecture standards.
* Manage platform changes across development, testing, and production environments.
* Work with ServiceNow Update Sets and Salesforce Change Sets/packages.
* Develop and execute automated and unit tests.
* Support release pipelines and controlled deployment processes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, integration documentation, and solution designs.
* Participate in design reviews and platform governance forums.
* Consider licensing, platform cost, maintainability, security, and upgrade impact when proposing solutions.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Hands\-on experience with
 **ServiceNow administration/configuration** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce administration/configuration** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **ITIL 4 and ITSM concepts** 
 .
* Understanding of CRM processes and enterprise customer operations.
* Experience with ServiceNow:
* Tables and forms
* Roles and ACLs
* Flow Designer
* Service Catalog
* Business Rules
* Client Scripts
